Dialogs.Dialog: Anegasaki
Hey, what kind of toothpaste do you use？
Hm？ Why do you ask？
I saw this really interesting toothpaste when I went to the drugstore.
Oh... what kind？
Avocado flavor.
Oh... wait, what!? Avocado!?
Right？ Surprising, isn't it.
I wonder if I should try it. Or maybe...
Maybe I should have you try it？
(Her stare is intense. ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲...)
Anegasaki
Hey, do you remember what I said about the avocado toothpaste？
...What is it again？
The one I found at the drugstore. Before... Ah, are you playing dumb？
Umm？
I knew it. Don't worry. I tried it myself.
You did？ Oh, sorry about that.
...Jeez, you fell for that so easily. I'm lying, I haven't bought it yet.
Eh！？
You really didn't want to try it. Makes sense, though.
(I mean, it's avocado!?)
Hey. Whatever happened with that avocado toothpaste？
Anegasaki
Ah. You remembered what I said. Good boy.
Haha...
Actually, I haven't bought it yet. I found another one I'm curious about.
What flavor？
Well, roasted sesame.
! That's quite a...
It takes courage to buy both at once, so I'm debating which one to get.
What should I do.
(I think they're both pretty bad...)
Anegasaki
I tried the avocado toothpaste.
Ah, the one you mentioned before... You chose that over the sesame.
Yeah, I figured this one fit the concept of morbid curiosity better.
Haha, so that was the concept. So, how was it？
I'd rather brush my teeth with a real avocado than use that.
...Was it really that bad？
Yeah. It tasted like they maximized all the worst parts of an avocado.
Want to try it if you're curious？ I only used it once, so there's plenty left.
I'll pass!
Anegasaki
Hah...
What's wrong, why the sigh？
Yeah. A friend got into a fight with her boyfriend... and I got dragged into it.
Dragged into it... Are you okay？
Yeah... What do you think caused the fight？
What was it？
Sauce or soy sauce on fried eggs？
Right？ You never know what'll start a fight, so... we should be careful.
...Hmm？
Which side are you on？
(She's asking me that here...?)
Anegasaki
Remember my friend who fought over fried egg toppings？
Yeah, I remember. Don't tell me... they fought again？
Bingo. What do you think the reason was this time？
Hmm... Food again？
Nope. Whether to sleep in pitch black or not.
Over something like that again？
Yeah. Apparently it's a big deal to the two of them.
Huh, I really don't get other couples.
Right？ We'd never fight over something like that.
...So, which side are you on？ We won't fight over it, so tell me？
(I feel like I should probably stay quiet here...)
Anegasaki
Hah...
What's wrong？
Yeah, the sauce and soy sauce...
Oh, you mean ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s friend and her boyfriend.
Right. Apparently they're in their honeymoon phase right now.
Well, that's good then.
Yeah, but I'm on edge wondering what'll start their next fight.
You worry too much, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. They're probably enjoying it.
Hmm, maybe. If they're just enjoying watching me panic, I won't forgive them.
But I think I might understand how your friend feels.
Hm？ What do you mean？
Uh... I don't know, just a hunch？
Jeez, don't tease your big sister.
By the way. About whether to sleep in pitch black or not...
Anegasaki
Hm？ Oh... what about it？
Which side are you on, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
Huh？ Did I not tell you？
Yeah. You asked me which side I was on, but...
I see.
I'm on... your side.
●'s side？
It means I'm fine with either.
Anegasaki
When I went shopping the other day, I forgot my point card and felt like I missed out.
That happens. And it's always when you're spending a lot, too.
Yeah, maybe I should just carry all my cards with me.
How many do you have?
Hmm, about thirty.
That many?!
Is that a lot? Maybe I should cut down on them.
But... hmm.
(Doesn't look like she'll be able to cut down...)
By the way, what happened with the point cards? Are you carrying them all?
Anegasaki
I tried, but... they're too bulky. My wallet became a total disaster.
I bet.
I wonder what everyone else does?
I think a lot of people struggle with that. You might just have to narrow down where you shop.
Yeah, I guess so.
But I want to get the best deals. Like, one store has cheap produce, another has cheap daily goods, and there are sale days... I can't just pick one!
Wow, you're gonna make a great housewife, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
You... think so? What do you consider a good housewife?
I think you're great, ●. You really think things through and manage well.
I see, yeah! In that case, I guess things are fine as they are...
(That doesn't solve the original problem at all, but... oh well.)
Anegasaki
You know how I asked you about my point cards before?
Yeah.
I asked my friends, and they said thirty is way too many.
How about taking out the ones for places you don't go to much?
Good idea. I'll leave the ones for stores I haven't been to in over a year at home.
A year?!
Yeah. Should I make it longer? Like two years?
Two years?! You definitely don't need to carry those around.
Huh? You think?
(I bet most of them are already expired...)
Anegasaki
About those point cards... you were totally right.
Told you, didn't I?
Yeah. Plus, a lot of them were actually expired.
I figured... I had a feeling that might be the case.
Are you a little exasperated?
No. Taking good care of things is very you, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. I like it.
That sounds like a smooth line. Do you really mean it?
I do. I like that you take care of things and that you're thrifty.
Hehe, thanks.
Having a wife like you, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, would be really reassuring.
Jeez, stop flattering me!
(Though she'd probably be thrifty with my allowance, too...)
Anegasaki
I've been making jewelry lately.
What kind of accessories are you making？
Bracelets and necklaces using natural stones. It's pretty fun.
Oh wow. I wanna see them!
Um, sorry. I don't have any on me right now. My friends wanted them.
You gave them away？ Well, can't be helped.
Yeah, they say their grades went up, or their confessions succeeded. It's kinda crazy.
Like lucky accessories？
That's what everyone says... But they're just normal accessories, really.
Then why don't you try wearing one yourself, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
Experiment on myself with my own creations？
Yeah, something like that.
Maybe I'll give it a try.
How's that lucky accessory you mentioned before, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
Anegasaki
Ah. About that...
I was testing its effects, but I gave it to a friend.
Wait, really？
We were having tea, and she took one look and said, "That's nice, I want it!" When they say that, I just wanna give it to them.
I see... Guess testing the effects is impossible.
Why？
I mean, if you wear it, everyone's gonna compliment it, right？
Hmm, true.
Then why not make a few of the same thing？ That way they might last a while.
Yeah, maybe I'll do that.
By the way, how are those lucky accessories？
Anegasaki
Yeah, about those... I made some, but I gave them away again.
Didn't you say you were going to make a few？
...I gave them all away.
I see... You really can't say no when asked, huh, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
Besides, it'd be unfair if I suddenly stopped giving them out, wouldn't it？
Makes sense... But if you keep giving them away, won't the material costs pile up？
Yeah, actually.
And I can't exactly charge them for it.
But I did it because I like it. I don't know if they really work, but everyone was happy, so it's fine.
(Yeah, as long as ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ is happy, I guess it's fine...)
Anegasaki
Come to think of it... lately, everyone's been giving me sweets and handmade trinkets as thanks.
Oh, does that mean they brought good luck again？
That's exaggerating. Though... they did say their wishes came true.
That's amazing. You really should make one for yourself.
No, it's fine. I thought about it, but I don't really have any wishes right now.
Huh？ Nothing at all？
Yeah, because I'm happy as I am. If you get too greedy, well, these stories usually end with the greedy person failing, right？
That's definitely a classic fairytale trope.
Right？ So I'm good. I don't want to let go of the happiness I have now.
Yeah, me too, ●. I hope things stay just like this forever.
Hehe, right？
Anegasaki
Hey, conveyor belt sushi has been pretty popular lately, hasn't it？
Is that so？
I've seen a lot of signs for them around the station and shopping street.
Now that you mention it, I have seen a few new ones.
Right？ I guess Japanese people really do love sushi.
Do you like it, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
Yeah. I like it when the rice is packed a bit firm and has a good vinegar kick.
Oh, so you're pretty particular about it？
A little. If the rice is too sweet or mushy, it's just a letdown.
It needs enough acidity to not ruin the topping, and be packed just right to eat...
(That's not just a little. You're super particular...)
Anegasaki
Looks like another new conveyor belt sushi place opened near the station.
Oh, another one？
There was a huge line, and when I looked to see what it was, it was a new place.
It really is popular, huh.
Most of the people in line were families with little kids.
Makes sense. It's probably healthier for kids than regular fast food.
Then our kids will have conveyor belt sushi instead of fast food.
Yeah... wait, what？
Hehe.
Conveyor belt sushi really is popular, isn't it.
Anegasaki
Why？
A lot of people in my class seem to use them instead of family restaurants.
Yeah... A family restaurant in my neighborhood actually turned into a sushi place.
I see. Then maybe Dexee's will eventually...
Eh？
Haha, probably not. We're doing pretty well.
It'll never disappear. I'm sure of it.
Eh？
It's where we first met. It's full of memories. If it disappeared, I'd...
Ah... sorry for getting so gloomy. It's fine, don't worry about it.
Oh, right. I'm sorry for being so insensitive the other day.
Anegasaki
Insensitive？
About Dexee's being replaced by a sushi place.
Ah... Oh no, were you worrying about that？
Well yeah, I made you sad, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
Hehe, you're so sweet.
But I thought about it later. Even if the place is gone, our memories remain.
Our memories won't change？
Right. As long as we don't change, that is.
Listen to me, saying such ominous things. The manager might cry if he heard me.
Haha, true...
Anegasaki

I wonder what stress drinking
tastes like.
Eh？

I wonder if it tastes
different from normal alcohol？

I don't even know what normal
alcohol tastes like...
Did something bad happen？

No, just curious. You see
scenes like that in dramas
a lot, right？

You're drinking out of
desperation, so I doubt
it tastes very good.

But would you go out of your
way to drink something gross
when you're already upset？

...Hm？ Maybe it's actually
good, but being upset makes
it taste bad to them？

So, would stress coffee or
stress milk work too？

I guess that'd be fine...
Weren't we talking about if
stress drinking tasted good？

Ah, right. But I guess we
won't know for sure until
we're old enough to drink.
Haha, you've got a point.
Anegasaki

Hey, stress eating is fun,
isn't it？

Is this a continuation of the
stress drinking talk？

Yeah. I don't get alcohol,
but I definitely understand
food.

I asked this before, but...
nothing bad actually
happened, right？

Well, my friend and I went
to buy some limited-edition
cosmetics, and they sold out
right in front of us.
Oh man...

We were so bummed out, we
decided to go to a family
restaurant and stress eat.
And it was fun？

Yeah, super fun. So I figured
stress drinking must be fun
and tasty too.

(I feel like those are two
different things...
but who knows.)
Anegasaki

I wonder if chugging amazake
counts as stress drinking.

...▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, don't tell me you're
actually admiring the idea of
stress drinking？
Huh, why do you say that？

You've just been weirdly
fixated on it lately...
Oh, was I making you worry？
A little.

Sorry, sorry. The truth is,
my current assignment is to
understand how adults feel.
What assignment？

It's with my friends. We see
how realistically we can
imagine situations only
adults understand.

We talk about it at lunch,
but I just don't get stress
drinking. It's my hardest
assignment right now.

(...Girls have weird ways of
having fun.)

What other assignments do
you have like the one you
mentioned？ The one with
your friends...
Anegasaki

Adult situations？ Let's see,
recently we talked about
being caught between a boss
and a subordinate.
...Huh.

And from there, we moved on
to the feelings of a
laid-off salaryman.
...That's rough.

Ah, you don't seem very
interested.

That's not true. I was just
thinking about how wild girls'
imaginations can be.
It is, you know？ Like, if you and I were adults...
If ● and ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ were adults...
I'll tell you the rest when we're adults.▼
(I wonder what she was imagining...)
Anegasaki
Dexy's is going to start a blog soon.
A blog？
Yeah. The manager wants to make the shop feel more approachable.
But isn't managing stuff like that a lot of work？
Yeah... I thought so too, but I somehow ended up taking the job.
You did, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲!?
Geez, don't look so surprised. I only agreed to write the posts. Don't worry.
(▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s blog, huh... I bet it'll be popular.)
Anegasaki
That Dexy's blog I mentioned before seems to be doing really well.
You're the one writing it, right, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
Yeah, the drafts. But the blog is titled 'Dexy's Manager Diary'.
Huh？ But you're not the manager, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
Geez, I'm just a part-timer.
The manager's always relying on you, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
Are you worried about me？ Thanks. But I'm actually having fun with it.
Having fun？
Yeah. It makes me happy when customers leave comments.
(Well, as long as ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ is having fun.)
Anegasaki
The other day, a customer came in saying they read the blog.
That's awesome!
Yeah, but...
...Hmm？
I was happy they came, but then they asked, 'Where's the manager？'
No way, they came for the manager？
Apparently they read the blog and became a fan... The manager was so lost.
Haha, I would've loved to see the manager like that.
It was a little funny, but... I feel bad for the customer, so I'll talk to the manager.
Yeah. I'll help you out too if anything happens, ●.
Thanks. I'll be fine.
I heard from the manager, but you're closing the blog？
Anegasaki
Yeah, it was only for a limited time anyway.
The manager really should have just taken it over.
The manager actually said we should keep it going a little longer.
Then it wasn't the manager who closed it？
...Actually, it was me.
Why did you, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
Because they wanted to make it an official waitress blog.
...Well, I'm sure it would be popular.
He even talked about changing the uniform design for it... I don't know what he'd make me do, so I figured closing it was for the best.
(...That's a smart call.)
Come to think of it, the girls in my class were making a fuss about a sale.
Anegasaki
Well, girls do love to shop, you know.
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, too？
I'm a girl too, you know...
That's not what I meant!
Sorry, I was just teasing you a little bit♪
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲！
Hehe, so cute▼
(I guess the sale talk is over... Oh well.)
Anegasaki
I actually went to a sale with my friends the other day, though.
So you really do like them too, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
I guess so. I might have a weakness for things like 'Bargain!' or 'Limited!'
So, did you find anything good？
Everyone else found some things they liked.
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, how about you？
I actually bought a bunch of stuff online right before that, so I held back.
Online shopping？
Yeah, it's pretty fun, you know？ I look through catalogs and imagine all sorts of things. But then...
You couldn't stop at just imagining it.
Sometimes♪
(I wonder what ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ ended up buying？)
About that online shopping you mentioned before, what do you usually buy, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
Anegasaki
Hmm, let's make it a quiz. Here we go.
Hmm, what could it be... Accessories or something？
Bzzzt! Don't you want to pick those out in person？
Right... Hmm... I have no idea. I give up. What？
Already？ Okay... Well, last time it was rice bowls, chopsticks, and pajamas.
That's pretty domestic. Why buy that online？
They were doing a feature on married couples' goods, and looking at it made me...
Wait, married!?
Ah, no! Looking at the feature just made me want them. I only actually bought them for myself, okay？
(That surprised me...)
Are you still doing that online shopping？
Anegasaki
I don't really use it that much. Lately I've just been window shopping.
So what have you been looking at lately？
Hmm... Ah!
...Hmm？
That's...a secret.
Now I'm curious. So, is it quiz time again？
No... I'm sure you'd never guess it in a million years.
Whoa, now I really want to know! What is it？
Well...
...Baby goods.
Anegasaki
Hah...
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, what's up？
Ah, sorry for sighing. ...You see, I think I dropped my planner somewhere.
Huh？ That's awful.
Yeah. I suspect I left it at that cafe I went to the other day. I was so sure it was in my bag...
If you know where it is, want to go look for it？
No... I called the shop and asked them to look for it, but...
They couldn't find it？
I went ahead and reported it to the police box, too. The officer said it might not turn up, though...
I really messed up. I guess I have no choice but to buy a new one.
I see... I hope you find it...
Okay, thanks.
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, did your planner ever turn up？
Anegasaki
No, it doesn't look like it. Thanks for worrying about me.
It seems the officer at the police box even asked the nearby shops for me.
Wow, I didn't know the police would go that far.
Yeah, he was really kind and helpful.
Was this police officer a young guy？
Huh？ No, he was an older gentleman. Why do you ask？
Then it's fine. Just... wondering, I guess.
Oh, are you jealous？ He was just being nice and looking for it. You can't be like that.
Well, maybe it was 'nice' as in he liked you.
Hey now, don't say such cute things, ▼
Anegasaki
I got a new planner. I managed to find one with the exact same design.
I see. Well, if you got the same one, you must've really liked the old one.
Yeah. The design, but it also had sentimental value. But it can't be helped. It was my own carelessness.
...Now that it's come to this, I really hope the old one never turns up anywhere.
Eh？ Why？
Actually... I was using it as a diary, too. The thought of someone seeing it had me worried sick.
I see.
...But it's fine now. I can just write new memories in my new planner.
Anegasaki
Hey, my planner turned up the other day.
Really？ That's great!?
Yeah, the owner of the cafe I stopped by that day held onto it, thinking I'd come back.
I'm glad they were nice.
But my carelessness ended up bothering a lot of people. I really need to reflect on that.
Don't be so down about it. At least you found it.
...Yeah. But you know, I think I'm going to use the new one instead of the old one.
Why？
After all, even in that short time, I've already written down new memories with you. I want to make just as many as before.
Alright, leave it to me！
Oh, thank you♪
Anegasaki
The other day, the manager was stressing over what a 'new service' should be...
Huh, even the manager thinks about stuff like that.
I'm sure he has struggles we don't know about. Probably.
Wait, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. Did he ask you to do something again？
No, it's nothing like that.
I just wondered if there was anything we could do to help.
You really can't ignore someone in trouble, can you, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
I just really love Dexee's. After all, it's the place where we first met.
Right？
Yeah. I wonder if there's anything ● can do to help.
About that new service for Dexee's... Did you come up with any good ideas？
Anegasaki
It'd be nice to match the decor and tableware to the seasons... but that'd be a lot of work.
Yeah, that's a big task. I guess the best service would be a discount, but...
That seems like it'd be difficult, too.
Yeah, true.
Hmm, it really is hard to figure out how to make customers happy.
● would be perfectly happy with just ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s smile. Plus, it's free.
That won't work. I can only show my best smile to you, you know.
Haha, I guess so.
Besides, it's not free.
Eh！？
I get plenty from you in return, after all.
Anegasaki
About the new service for Dexee's... I think we should tailor it to the customer's age and gender.
Everyone wants something different, after all.
Like a free large portion for customers who want to eat a lot. Or smaller rice portions with dessert for women...
That's good. And a toy for the kids？
Exactly. And for the elderly... a shoulder massage ticket？
Eh？
Um... I was joking.
A shoulder massage ticket from ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ sounds great. ● would like one, too.
You don't need a ticket.
My face is my ticket？
Jeez, don't push your luck.
Anegasaki
I just thought of something for Dexee's new service.
Oh, what is it？
Memorizing the customers' names.
？ And then what？
When they're waiting, they write their names down, right？ Then when they leave, we use their name to say thank you.
Makes sense... But for someone who just had a great idea, you seem kind of down？
Well, I actually already told the manager about it.
What was that？
He said people are sensitive about personal info lately. Some customers might feel uncomfortable if we memorize their names.
Ah... It's a tough world.
I thought it was a good idea, but the manager said the new service is on hold. So that's that.
(I guess it really is too hard for part-timers to come up with this stuff...)
Anegasaki
Hey, do you know the movie 'The Tent'？
Is it a horror movie？
Yeah, it's an older one. It wasn't rated very well when it came out, but it's a hidden gem.
Oh？ What's it about？
It's about a group of men and women trapped in a mountain lodge during a snowstorm.
Haha, sounds typical. Does a serial killer show up, as expected？
Of course. If they don't show up, nothing would happen, right？
Of course...
The weight of the snow cuts the phone lines, and the road down the mountain gets blocked off...
(▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ looks so lively...)
Anegasaki
I watched it on TV a little while ago. Do you know the movie 'Slope'？
Could it be... a horror movie？
Roughly speaking, yes. But it's not really a splatter film.
So there's no serial killer.
Oh, there is.
There is...
But rather than a killer, it's more like a monster？ It has no face.
Like a Noppera-bo...
No, it's an American movie. It has nothing from the neck up. And then...
Anegasaki
The movie I rented yesterday wasn't very interesting.
A dud, huh？ That happens.
It's a classic setup where zombies attack a town, but it wasn't an homage, just a cheap parody.
Yes...
If it was at least funny, it would have been fine.
Funny？ It's a horror movie, right？
There are funny horror movies, right？
I don't really get it, ●...
Really？ That's strange...
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. Did you watch that psycho-horror movie on TV the other day？
Anegasaki
Could it be... 'Psycho's Temptation'？
Yeah, that's the one. I just happened to watch it.
Me too... Ah, then you understand, right？
Understand what？
What a funny horror movie is.
...Why？
You didn't find Psycho-san funny？
...It was so scary I actually stopped watching it halfway through.
Eeeeh！？
No good？
Hopeless. I won't ask you to understand my tastes, but if we're this far off, it's a serious problem...
(Whaaat！？)
Anegasaki
Hey, did you have a favorite hero growing up？
Like from live-action shows or anime？
Movies or books are fine too. Boys all look up to that kind of thing, right？
Hmm, I guess I had a phase like that.
Then, did you practice their special moves？
Yeah, maybe I did. Like, 'Something-wave~'. Pretty seriously too.
You really are a boy.
Girls don't do that？
Normally, I wonder. In my case, it wasn't special moves...
...But rather？
...It's actually embarrassing, so it's a secret.
(I'm worried...)
Anegasaki
Apparently there's a popular superhero show right now.
Oh, what's it about？
I don't know the details, but the neighborhood kids are always shouting out their special moves. Every day.
Huh. Some things never change, do they.
But they all have different special moves. Like, Dragon Scream! Or... Rolling Tiger!
...What do you mean？
It seems there are a lot of heroes. And they're all fighting each other.
Are there no bad guys？
The bad guys are aliens. There's a ton of heroes in one organization, and they're protecting the Earth, but...
The leader of the group is a girl. And the heroes all started fighting over her...
(I wonder if that really counts as a hero show...)
Anegasaki
You remember that hero show I mentioned before, where they fight over a girl？
The one you said was popular recently？
Yeah. A few of my classmates watch it. It seems to be popular with high schoolers.
Isn't it for kids？
Technically, yes... But apparently it's full of really handsome guys.
Ah, because there are so many heroes...
It seems a lot of moms who watch with their kids are fans too. Modern hero shows are really different now.
Are you curious about it too, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
Hehe, I wonder.
Hey, don't be jealous. I've got my very own hero, so I'm perfectly happy♪
...Are you talking about ●？
If I'm ever in a pinch, you'll come flying, right？
Haha, leave it to me!
You said you had a favorite hero when you were little too, right, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
Anegasaki
Where did this come from？
You said before that you used to practice special moves...
I told you, it wasn't a special move. ...You probably wouldn't know it anyway.
Was it that obscure of a show？
...An old historical drama. I saw it on reruns.
Wow, that's old-school!
A samurai in a woven hat would flip his hem and turn around. Even though he was a man, it was so sexy...
Hm？ What's wrong？
Your facial structure might be a little similar. Like your jawline and neck...
Eh？
No, it's nothing! ...You really are my hero, aren't you？
I heard there was some commotion at Dexee's the other day？
Anegasaki
Ah, that. But it wasn't really a big deal.
A five-year-old kid was running around the store and tripped.
Was he okay？
Yeah, just scraped his knee. But he spilled another customer's food... His mom scolded him, and he started crying so hard.
I see...
